rawContent: The #metoo movement and the broader, long-overdue acknowledgement of sexist and racism in science seems to have some created a frame of sorts where somehow having suffered these abuses would have some women assume we are beyond reproach, our behaviours beyond questioning. >

This is my concern with the #metoo movement. Yes, abusers must be held accountable. But then what? What is the endgame? 

We need to dedicate resources to preventing abuse and not only to punishing it.

Am I the only one who's noticed that the bulk of headlines about #coronavirusus involve the economy? 

Same as with #ClimateCrisis. The planet is going to hell in a hand basket but the top concern of those in power remains money. 

Really makes me wonder if we deserve saving.
@TheAnnaGat If #Covid_19 and the #ClimateCrisis aren't enough to convince people of how desperately we need this and of how grossly overdue it is, I don't know what will.
